description: Decode a 17-character VIN, e.g. query "1HGCM82633A004352": full vehicle specification (make, model, year, body, engine and more) from NHTSA vPIC. The query must be the VIN itself. Source: NHTSA vPIC (public domain). License: Public domain (U.S. federal government).

query.description: Search term for this source (see the tool description for what it expects).
